Board-writer commits (`board: ...`, `foreman tick [ci skip]`, `qa-cron: ...`) carry no trailer, so the test fails on most commits. Replay: b070d0d parent -> subtest absent (false control); 34e473d -> TAMPER_DETECTED because the trailer it added points at prompts/gap-004/v1.md which does NOT exist in the tree; 97ea52b -> ATTESTATION_MISSING; acf2c90 -> ATTESTATION_MISSING. CI has been red on 4 of the last 8 pushes on master; last red on 2026-09-10. NEW EVIDENCE (hook analysis): .gitreins/commit-msg ALREADY auto-appends `Prompt: prompts/coding-hermes/v1.md` when a commit message lacks a Prompt trailer, and its own comment admits the reason: "A trailer-less commit breaks pkg/prompt TestVerify on CI (INT-CI-001: the stand-in PM's gap-push d84ed93 bypassed this hook with --no-verify and went red)". It is not sufficient: measured, the trailer is present on 94da863 and 87d9a15 but ABSENT on acf2c90 (the pushed HEAD, `qa-cron: ...`) and on 9dd9ad1 (the previous dogfood commit) — i.e. the machine writers bypass or pre-date the hook (12 recent commits carry [ci skip]), and CI tests whichever commit was pushed. A commit-msg hook can never guarantee the ambient HEAD at test time; the test itself must not read HEAD.
